steps.assertion: Accounting receives the approved mixed-payer Batch
steps.text: Open **Expenses > Expense Batches** and choose an approved Batch. **Post batch** is the primary action; the summary says how much is company-paid and how much is owed to the employee.

steps.assertion: Post the company-paid side and open native reimbursement
steps.text: Choose **Post batch**. The company-paid expenses are posted at once; for the employee-paid ones Odoo opens its posting wizard.

steps.assertion: Complete the native employee-paid posting wizard
steps.text: Confirm **Post Expenses** in the wizard. The journal and date are the ones Odoo proposes for expense reports.

steps.assertion: Both mixed-payer journal entries are available for review
steps.text: Both journal entries are listed: one for the company-paid side, one for the reimbursement owed to the employee. Each links back to the Batch.
